# Real NOAA GHCN-D yearly fixtures

These compact public NOAA extracts preserve original CSV, fixed-width station/inventory, and monthly `.dly` lines. `manifest.json` pins each committed file, decoded CSV hashes, observed counts, and expected missingness. `provenance.json` pins the full retained originals, official URLs, acquisition times, selection rules, and coverage limits. Full annual downloads stay outside Git.

The main fixture has 1,110 usable core rows: 10 representative stations in the 10 agricultural states, September 10–October 16, 2026. Additional original catalog examples preserve real lowercase `US10adam008` (37 observed PRCP-only rows in NE) and hyphenated `BR00A6-0010` (outside agricultural states), plus underscored `US10box_001` (NE, PRCP inventory ends2024 and is correctly ineligible for2026), plus `CA1NS000227` with an original UTF-8 descriptive name. Fixed-position identity/state fields must use their original byte offsets. Eligible station selection must retain the rainfall-only station rather than require all three elements at each station. Separate genuine observed edge rows include positive, negative, and zero temperature, trace precipitation (`MFLAG=T`), and a rejected quality flag (`QFLAG=S`). They are source observations, not injected faults.

Cross-year files contain original annual CSV rows for December 31, 2025 and January 1, 2026. The 11-station extract genuinely lacks January 1 TMIN at `USC00210075`; the independent Des Moines three-field subsets are complete both days. These two days establish year routing/parsing, not a 30-day readiness window.

The independent `USW00014933` CSV subset has 108 rows through October 15; all three October 16 core rows are genuinely absent. Its exact integer values and measurement/quality/source flags match the retained original `.dly` cells. `numeric-oracles.json` records these comparisons and exact rational conversion formulas. `.dly` has no annual CSV observation-time field; none is reconstructed. The independent check is not a comparison with the AccessJSON API's rounding.

All parents were acquired October 19, 2026. Observation date, reference session, and acquisition vintage remain distinct; these mutable files do not establish historical point-in-time availability. Subset `.csv.gz` files use deterministic recompression of original lines and are not the original full HTTP response bytes. Controlled test mutations must remain labeled and may never replace these real baseline bytes or count as source reliability observations.
